metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds one glass, a share of thirty-five shillings, evening prayer, and supper.

yesterday: The sermon was one glass. A cloud of witnesses, to be followed. Evening prayer was its own service.
Thirty-five shillings, your part, received. Christmas is still written as expected.
You are cast on Monday in the Navarre comedy at two. Thursday is the king again, and you are in it.
At supper she said six years, and the ink on Monday. The horn is the old horn. Verbeke went out by the north door.
The one page is still one page. You looked. The friar's letter is the question on the page.
